outputText: {"status": "ANSWERED", "answer": "同日キャンセルは3,000円（1人あたり）です。連絡なしの場合も、連絡ありの場合も3,000円と記載されています。", "sensitiveCategory": "NONE", "citations": [{"documentId": "nishi:document:640aefb5dd7247bd:0", "statementId": "nishi:statement:135", "quote": "On-the-day cancellation (no notice): 3,000 yen (per person)"}, {"documentId": "nishi:document:640aefb5dd7247bd:0", "statementId": "nishi:statement:136", "quote": "On-the-day cancellation (with notice): 3,000 yen (same as above)"}]}
